svg.title: Butler reviews the week in the background while you keep talking
svg.desc: A Butler window. You ask Butler to go through the garden project and summarize this week's changes. Butler takes it on in the background and shows its progress above the composer. Meanwhile you ask when the preview ships and Butler answers right away from memory: Friday, Oct 2. When the background review is done, Butler posts the weekly summary in the same conversation: 12 changes merged, 2 risky items flagged, on track for Friday's preview.
